t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Some gnomes have higher values than others, although this might not be the case. Keep a mental note of which colour gnomes give higher outcomes.

vb_textbox.text: I am convinced there was no correlation between the colour of the gnome/basket and the number of mushrooms received. However, there was not sufficient time to accurately measure whether there was a pattern, so make of that as you will. Personally, I would just click whichever gnome you feel like clicking, but of course feel free to try to establish a pattern. Also bear in mind that I got a score of over 300 from clicking randomly. The person before me also believed there was no significant pattern.
